question_en: Can I submit a leave request for a past date?

question_en: How do I request a half day of leave?
answer_en: Choose the half-day duration and use the same date for both the start and end. ELMS records a valid half-day request as 0.5 day; a half-day request cannot span multiple dates.

question_en: Can I submit leave that overlaps another request?
answer_en: ELMS blocks a new request when any selected date overlaps one of your pending or approved requests. Cancel an eligible pending request or choose a non-overlapping date range before submitting again.
